guidance.said: The company expects to achieve high single-digit volume growth in the band of 8-10% going forward.

guidance.said: The company aims to maintain its operating margin guidance band of 18-20% through cost efficiencies, mix improvement, and price increases.

business: Asian Paints Limited manufactures and sells decorative and industrial coatings, offering comprehensive painting and waterproofing services, along with a wide range of home decor products including kitchens, baths, lighting, furnishings, and window solutions. The main business segments comprise Decorative Coatings, International Operations, Industrial Coatings joint ventures, and Home Decor.
